query:
UPDATE model_reindex_assets
        SET
            status = CASE WHEN $3 THEN 'done' ELSE 'failed' END,
            error_message = CASE WHEN $3 THEN NULL ELSE $4 END,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE reindex_run_id = $1
        AND asset_id = $2
        AND status = 'queued'
        RETURNING true AS "changed!"
